title: node_capabilities validation rejects Capability IntFlag values
description: Robustness review of 99sg.2 (pass 3, finding 2): node.py Node.__post_init__ validates node_capabilities with type(v) is not int, which rejects Capability IntFlag values — node_capabilities=Capability.EGRESS raises ValueError even though Capability (python/src/lichen/crypto/capability_announcements.py:29) is the package's canonical expression of these bits and create_capability_announcement accepts Capability | int. Rejecting bool is correct and intentional; isinstance(v, int) and not isinstance(v, bool) preserves that while accepting IntFlag.
